summary: An island trip episode with a small, purely affectionate comment section. Dream dominates it — a female viewer says even she is falling for her, another praises her singing a Disney song, another names her and Goy as the favourite pairing. The only other note is admiration for the group's inexhaustible energy on travel shoots. No criticism, no requests, and very little to extract; at 1.04M views and 404 comments this is a low-conversation entry in the series, consistent with trip episodes that lack a relationship premise or a guest.
